scripts.render:all: agenticvids render src/index.tsx -c ledger --out out/ledger.mp4 && agenticvids render src/index.tsx -c orbit --out out/orbit.mp4 && agenticvids render src/index.tsx -c nimbus --out out/nimbus.mp4 --crf 21 && agenticvids render src/index.tsx -c archdev --out out/archdev.mp4 --crf 20 && agenticvids render src/index.tsx -c archdev2 --out out/archdev2.mp4 --crf 20
scripts.review: for id in ledger orbit nimbus archdev archdev2; do agenticvids review src/index.tsx -c $id --video out/$id.mp4 || true; done
